Metadata.title: UnaMonne
Metadata.description: Handmade gold jewellery from a Tbilisi workshop. Small runs, hand engraving, shipped worldwide.

HomePage.title: Made for the hands that wear it.
HomePage.featuredBody: The pieces our customers come back for — cast in recycled gold, finished by hand at the bench.
HomePage.workshopBody: Four people, one courtyard in Vera. We keep the runs small so the finishing stays ours — every crescent is engraved by hand before it leaves the bench.

faq.sizingA: Wrap a paper strip around the base of your finger and measure it in millimetres, in the evening when hands are warmest. Or ask us — we post a free sizing ring inside Georgia.
faq.returnsA: Fourteen days, unworn, in the original box. Engraved and made-to-order pieces are final sale, so check the spelling twice.
faq.giftA: Every order ships in a linen pouch with a handwritten card. Tick “gift” in your bag and we leave the price off the slip.
faq.paymentA: In Georgia you pay in GEL through Bank of Georgia. Everywhere else in USD through Stripe — the currency follows your region and you can switch it in the header.
